title: Sorting and Counting
seo_title: Sorting and Data – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Sort objects by colour, shape, size or kind; count each group; read simple picture graphs and tally marks. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: sort by colour, shape and size, find the odd one out, and read picture graphs. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Put things that are the same together
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Choose a rule: colour, shape, size or kind.
  • Put the things that match the rule together.
  • Count each group to see which has the most.

Examples

Example

Sort: ● ■ ● ● ■. How many circles?

Circles: ● ● ●

Answer: 3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using two rules at onceSort by one rule at a time.
Counting a thing in two groupsEach thing goes in one group only.
Reading the graph from the wrong sideCount the pictures in each row.
